label: NATURE_SOURCE_2: x's own form or quiddity is an efficient cause of x's having r
term: efficient causation by a thing's own quiddity (quiddityEfficientlyCauses x r)
definition: NatureSource.quiddityEfficientlyCauses x r: x's own form or quiddity is an efficient cause of x's having r ('causatum ab ipsa forma vel quiditate rei (dico sicut a causa efficiente)', De ente c.3 [69874]). Efficient means a source from which the having of r proceeds as from an agent, as the q.77 a.6 reading of a subject that actively causes its proper accidents; a merely formal principle by which x has r is excluded. Whether such causing is the thing's own causing (CausesIn x x r) is the separate source reading QuiddityCausingEsseIsSelfCausationReading, not part of this definition. In Lean it is a primitive field.
